decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service that leverages the firm's support team and fits its agency-focused value proposition, premium customer support is likely to meet or stay near aspiration levels and is easy to carry with current organisational slack.

The software version management tool builds directly on the hosting platform and in-house development base, so even with some uncertainty management would likely retain it as a strategic complement unless results clearly fall short.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting business, management would be more likely to redeploy resources away from it if its performance is below aspiration levels despite some available slack.

Scalable hosting for agencies is highly aligned with the firm's established offer, target customers, and growth path, so in a growing market it is the least likely of the four products to be taken off the market.
